Pictures in the inspection window: A card's Code node shows a preview of the card in an inspection window, drawn from its data; pilots, places and foes show their art, and the art rolls up to the loops above.

Steward 2026-11-22, from KEYWORDS.md and PRs #143-#156: Now says twelve keywords landed at 2.98; since then Hover, Move/Guide, Trample, Aimed, Pre-empt, At dusk, Flanked, Resonance and Burn have too. Refresh Now and count what of P2 is left.

Steward 2026-11-22, from docs/reference/VEHICLES.md (2.104, PR #147): the Crossing, the big-map mission with pocket vehicles, is the one mission kind with no loop beside m.swarm..m.heart. Add m.crossing.

Steward 2026-11-22, from docs/reference/PETS.md and RUN_AND_ECONOMY.md (2.107-2.119): a haven now offers strays, gear cards paid in banked Omni and the nine-of-the-collection loadout; Now still says gear only since 2.89.

Steward 2026-11-22, from docs/reference/SCALING.md (2.110, PR #151) and FOE 180% (2.122): missions are sized by squad power and a full wipe ends the expedition. The stake hole's near-100% numbers predate both; re-measure with tools/sim.js 40 before tuning.

Steward 2026-11-22, from PR #158 (2.122): every clade now has an instinct, one always-on rule. The draft can show a pilot's instincts beside its keyword chips, so a two-clade pick reads as two animals before any card.

Steward 2026-11-23, from RUN_AND_ECONOMY.md (2.132, PR #179): the route is now a map of Tumult, camp on the left, the threat far right, branching paths across a landscape. Now still says stop cards since 2.70; refresh it and ask whether the map's distance to the threat can carry the expedition's stake.

Steward 2026-11-23, from MISSIONS_AND_BESTIARY.md (2.135, PR #181): an elite stop may be held by a rival pilot, human and two clades, under a name. A rival is a character, so it can feed arc.canon: one question about who it was and why it was on that stretch.

Steward 2026-11-23, from MISSIONS_AND_BESTIARY.md (2.134, PR #180): every foe is a triple hybrid with a hybrid card and a level, and telegraphs a face instead of its role's move. Now says only the forecast; the telegraph can name the face's keywords, so reading the round's intents is reading three animals.

Steward 2026-11-23, from PETS.md (2.133, PR #178): upgrade points now also awaken a pet's Ethereal faces, so a pilot's growth is split between its traits and its pets. Measure how often the look-ahead player spends on the pet (tools/sim.js 40) before calling it a real choice.

Steward 2026-11-23, from AUDIO.md (2.130, PR #174): Cosmic Shore's music and effects are in, with an Audio studio. Now names only chips and tips; check that every keyword landing has a sound of its own, so a pulse reads by ear as well as by eye.
